tools_hub_intro_east: Find Ganjiday’s BaZi and Zi Wei Dou Shu charts, tarot spreads and reference pages in one directory. Standard results are free, and some tools offer an optional full reading.
tools_hub_intro_west: Browse tarot spreads and numerology calculators from Arcanumber. You can get the standard results without an account.
tools_hub_start_east: To see your Four Pillars, start with the {main}. If you’re thinking through a particular situation, try {tarot}.
tools_hub_start_west: Have a birth date handy? Try the {main}. To reflect on a question, try {tarot}.
tools_hub_group_chart_intro: Use your birth date, time and place for a full chart. BaZi can also show three pillars if your birth time is unknown.
tools_hub_group_relation_intro: Two charts or two zodiac signs, side by side. Scores and relationships are a traditional reference only.
tools_hub_group_yearly_intro: How the stems and branches of a year or a day relate to a chart.
tools_hub_group_divination_intro: Choose a spread, draw your cards and read what each position means in the tradition.
tools_hub_group_calendar_intro: Solar dates, lunar dates, stems and branches, and the zodiac animals, side by side.
tools_hub_group_knowledge_intro: Look up the terms you see in a chart, or explore traditional tarot card meanings.
tools_hub_group_tarot_intro: Try a one-card draw or a longer spread, then look up the cards you drew.
tools_hub_group_numerology_intro: Use your birth date to find your Life Path number, or use your name to work out other core numbers.
tools_hub_group_astrology_intro: The twelve signs: dates, element, modality and ruling planet.
tools_hub_group_moon_intro: See tonight’s Moon phase and find the dates of upcoming new and full moons.
tools_hub_group_compatibility_intro: Compare two Life Path numbers and use their traditional interpretations as prompts for reflection.
tools_hub_tool_tarot_daily: One card a day, read upright or reversed.
tools_hub_tool_tarot_yes_or_no: Draw one card and see whether its traditional meaning leans yes, no or maybe.
tools_hub_tool_tarot_celtic_cross: The classic ten-card spread, position by position.
tools_hub_tool_tarot_card_index: All 78 cards, each with its own page.
tools_hub_tool_almanac: Solar, lunar and stem-branch dates side by side, with the day's traditional notes.
tools_hub_tool_zodiac: Find a zodiac animal from a birth date, by both the Start of Spring and Lunar New Year.
tools_hub_tool_numerology: Where numerology comes from and how each number is worked out.
tools_hub_season_east_summary: In BaZi, the Ding-Wei year begins at the Beginning of Spring on February 4, 2027 (China Standard Time). Explore the traditional readings for the Fire Goat year.
tools_hub_season_west_summary: See how much of the Moon is lit tonight and when the next new and full moons occur.
